title: Set 292

sentences.ko: 누나가 하도 가자고 해서 토요일에 조카 축구 대회에 따라갔어. 한 경기면 끝날 줄 알았는데 계속 이기는 바람에 거의 여섯 시까지 밖에 있었어. 겉옷도 안 챙겨 갔거든.
sentences.text: My sister talked me into going to my nephew's soccer tournament on Saturday. I figured it'd be like one game, but they kept winning, so we were out there until almost six, and I didn't even bring a jacket.

alts.text: Got dragged to my nephew's soccer tournament Saturday, thanks to my sister. Thought it'd be one game, but they just kept winning, so we were stuck out there till almost six, and I didn't even have a jacket.

My sister persuaded me to attend my nephew's soccer tournament on Saturday. I assumed it would be a single game, but the team continued to win, so we remained there until nearly six o'clock, and I had not brought a jacket.

sentences.note: **talked me into** 는 누가 설득해서 내가 하기 싫던 일을 하게 됐다는 뜻이에요. casual 의 **got dragged to** 는 억지로 끌려갔다는 느낌을 더 세게 줍니다.

sentences.ko: 진짜 미안해. 알람을 오전 여섯 시가 아니라 오후 여섯 시로 맞춰 놨는데, 폰 봤더니 벌써 여덟 시 반이더라. 그제야 알았어.
sentences.text: I'm so sorry, I set my alarm for six p.m. instead of six a.m., and I didn't figure it out until I looked at my phone and it was already eight thirty.

alts.text: Ugh, sorry! I set my alarm for six p.m., not six a.m., and didn't realize till I checked my phone and it was already eight thirty.
I sincerely apologize. I set my alarm for six p.m. rather than six a.m., and I did not realize my mistake until I looked at my phone and saw that it was already eight thirty.

sentences.note: **figure it out** 은 무엇이 어떻게 된 건지 알아내다, 알아차리다는 뜻이에요. **instead of** 로 원래 하려던 것과 실제로 한 것을 맞대어 말합니다.

sentences.ko: 오늘 밤에 그 스피닝 수업 가려고 했는데, 전날 예약해야 하는 거더라고. 생각났을 때는 이미 자리가 다 찼어. 그냥 가서 러닝머신이라도 탈 수 있었겠지만, 솔직히 좀 다행이다 싶었어.
sentences.text: I was going to go to that spin class tonight, but you have to book it the day before, and by the time I remembered, it was full. I guess I could've just gone and used the treadmill, but honestly, I was kind of relieved.

alts.text: Was gonna hit that spin class tonight, but you gotta book the day before, and by the time I remembered, it was full. Coulda just used the treadmill, I guess, but honestly? Kinda relieved.

I had intended to attend the spin class this evening, but it must be booked one day in advance, and by the time I remembered, it was already full. I suppose I could have gone and used the treadmill instead, but to be honest, I was somewhat relieved.

sentences.note: **by the time I remembered** 는 내가 생각났을 때는 이미 늦었다는 뜻이에요. **I could've just** 는 그렇게 할 수도 있었지만 안 했다고 말할 때 씁니다.
sentences.situation: 운동 가려다 말게 된 핑계 대기

sentences.ko: 좋아, 그럼 네가 목요일밖에 못 쉬면 그냥 월요일 말고 일요일 밤에 돌아오자. 거기서 꽉 찬 날은 사흘밖에 안 되지만, 네가 휴가를 하루 더 쓰는 것보다는 그게 나아.
sentences.text: Okay, so if you can only get Thursday off, then let's just fly back Sunday night instead of Monday. We'd only get three full days there, but I'd rather do that than have you use up another vacation day.

alts.text: Okay, if Thursday's the only day you can get off, let's just fly back Sunday night, not Monday. It's only three full days there, but better that than you burning another vacation day.

If you are only able to take Thursday off, then I suggest we return on Sunday evening rather than Monday. We would have only three full days there, but I would prefer that to you using another vacation day.

sentences.note: **get Thursday off** 는 목요일에 쉬다, 휴가를 받다는 뜻이에요. **I'd rather do that than** 은 둘 중 이쪽이 낫다고 고를 때 쓰고, **use up** 은 아껴 둔 것을 써 버린다는 느낌입니다.

sentences.ko: 두 시에 배송 완료됐다고 나오는데, 나 하루 종일 집에 있었고 아무도 안 왔어. 이웃들한테도 벌써 물어봤는데, 택배 회사에서는 내일까지 기다려야 분실 신고라도 할 수 있대.
sentences.text: It says it was delivered at two o'clock, but I've been home all day and nobody came to the door. I already asked the neighbors, and now the delivery company is telling me I have to wait until tomorrow before I can even report it missing.

alts.text: It says delivered at two o'clock, but I've been home all day and nobody came by. Already asked the neighbors, and now the delivery company's saying I gotta wait till tomorrow just to report it missing.

According to the tracking information, it was delivered at two o'clock, but I have been at home all day and no one came to the door. I have already asked my neighbors, and the delivery company is now informing me that I must wait until tomorrow before I am able to report it as missing.

sentences.note: **It says** 는 화면이나 안내에 그렇게 나와 있다고 말할 때 써요. **report it missing** 은 분실 신고를 하다는 뜻입니다.
